fixed.summary: On the web host an SDR display no longer gets an extended-range (HDR) canvas, which clipped everything above SDR white: og.Sky drew white by day where the native host draws it blue. The engine's Worker cannot ask `(dynamic-range: high)`, so the renderer took every display for HDR; the page now asks and tells it, and `best` stays at standard range (Display P3 where offered) on an SDR display. RenderCapabilities.hdr is false there.
